items.q: Which POS systems does VILAX work with?
items.a: In Russia, iiko and Quick Resto. Accounting and stock come in from 1C and MoySklad, targets and reference data from Google Sheets.

It depends on the POS and the number of locations; your manager will give you a timeline after the demo. With annual billing, standard onboarding is included: one connection, access set-up and a kick-off session for the team.

items.q: Who can see the group’s data?
items.a: Only the people you give access to. Access is set by role and location: a location manager sees their location, the owner sees the whole group.

items.q: Can we connect only some blocks?
items.a: Yes. You choose the blocks; the price per location is the sum of the ones you pick and is the same for every location in the group. The tier depends on how many locations run on VILAX.

items.q: What group size does VILAX start from?
items.a: From 2 locations. The price per location is the same for every location and goes down as the group grows.
Monthly or annually in advance. Annual billing gives 16.7% off and includes standard onboarding. Prices exclude VAT; VAT at 22% is added on top.
The Coordinator, AI reports across the group, is included in Core at no extra cost.
No separate app is needed: the system runs in the browser on desktop and mobile, and group summaries arrive in Telegram.
